name: Deepexi Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Deepexi Technology Co., Ltd. provides enterprise-level big-model AI application solutions in China. the company offers solutions based on technology infrastructure, FastData enterprise data intelligence solution based on FastData Foil Data Fusion Platform; and FastAGI enterprise AI solution based on Deepexi enterprise large model platform. It serves consumer goods, manufacturing, healthcare, and transportation industries. The company was formerly known as Beijing Deepexi Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Deepexi Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2025. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Haidian, China.
